text: Oh, I bet you're here to check out the room for rent. You're in the way, dude. What? Run fast, run far. That should have been my first clue. text: We built the pyramids, math, science, history, unraveling the mystery of all, started with a big bang, hey!

text: I'm looking for Shelton Cooper's apartment. So Shelton's last roommate tried to warn you off?

text: For all I knew, he was the crazy one. He had this really deranged look.
